## Acceptance

- `go build`, `go vet`, `golangci-lint` and the architecture lint all run clean
- The coverage gate runs from backend/tests and reports against the exclusion list
- The thin-client lint fails on money arithmetic and on a hardcoded threshold
- `docker compose up postgres redis` comes up healthy
- A fresh session can read STATE.md and know exactly what to do next
